name: Bookteq
shortDescription: UK venue-booking software from My Local Pitch for halls, rooms and other community spaces, with online bookings, payments and reporting.
company: My Local Pitch Limited (company number 08427059), trading as Playfinder
suitableContexts: Churches or charities that hire out halls, rooms or facilities
Parishes with several bookable spaces and formal hire administration
Venues needing online payment and invoice workflows

pricing.summary: Bookteq currently publishes a software package from £100 per month. It also offers enterprise add-ons and managed services at quoted prices. Confirm the price, payment fees, VAT treatment, contract term and fit for a church or charity venue before purchase.

tiers.label: Bookteq software
tiers.detail: Self-service bookings and payments, account management and multi-venue administration.

tiers.label: Enterprise add-ons and managed services
tiers.detail: Lockteq, Bookteam and fully managed-lettings options.

gdprInformation: Bookteq’s privacy notice identifies My Local Pitch Limited as the operator and data controller, gives a UK company number and contact address, and was last updated in May 2025. It does not by itself establish a church’s data-processing agreement, sub-processors, hosting locations, retention or support arrangements; obtain current contractual material before handling hirer or volunteer data.
coreFeatures: Online hall, room and facility bookings
Stripe card, Apple Pay and Google Pay payments
integrations: Bookteq booking widget for organisation websites
importExport: Supplier describes financial and booking reports
Confirm current import, export, data-retention and exit formats before purchase
support: Supplier publishes dedicated account management and support as part of the Bookteq package
Published sales and support hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00
Confirm implementation, incident and weekend-support arrangements before purchase

uk-operator.value: Bookteq’s privacy notice identifies My Local Pitch Limited, company number 08427059, as the legal entity that owns and operates the online booking system.

product-scope.value: Supplier pages describe UK venue and community-space bookings with self-service scheduling, payments, invoices and reporting.

published-pricing.value: The pricing page publishes Bookteq software from £100 per month and quotes enterprise add-ons and managed services separately.

payment-workflow.value: Supplier documentation describes Stripe card payments, Apple Pay and Google Pay, invoices and payment schedules for venue bookings.

editorial.assessment: Bookteq is general UK venue-booking software, not a church-management system or a church-specialist product. It is relevant where a church, parish or charity operates substantial hall or room hire and needs mature booking, payment and reporting workflows. Smaller volunteer-run halls should compare its cost and operational complexity with church-specific and lower-cost alternatives.
bestFor: Larger church or charity venues with multiple spaces
Teams needing online booking, payments, invoices and reporting in one system
Organisations that need centralised multi-venue controls
strengths: Identified active UK operator and privacy notice
Online bookings, approvals, payments, invoices and reporting are documented
Multi-venue and community-space workflows are explicit
limitations: The starting price may be disproportionate for a small volunteer-led hall
Obtain current payment-fee, VAT, contract-term and charity-pricing details before purchase
Detailed data-processing, export and exit arrangements are not established by the reviewed public pages

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing recurring church-hall or multi-room hire with online payments and formal reporting
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK venue-management product with a published starting price, online booking widget and payment workflows
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request a demonstration using the church’s real hire rules, invoice process, access permissions and cancellation policy, then obtain current data-processing and exit terms
